x: Smart, who is a first-claim member of the Orion Harriers, finished second on handicap; while third place was gained by Dick Michael, who is better known as a track runner.
Then we had Dick Michael 4th, Harry Shields 5th, and Arthur Allum 9th. We won the team race by scoring 20 points to Micham's A.C.'s 22, a narrow margin but a winning one.

…Morrell 6th, all our runners in this race scored points to put us in the lead. The 880 yards was won by Alby Bird, with Dick Michael second. They had a ding-dong struggle which took them well away from their field.…
The S.A.A.L. 4 x 440 yards was also down for decision and we had to ask Jarlett and Gray to turn out once more for the Club, together with Dick Michael and Frank Webb.
Dick Michael made a fine substitute, however, and he ran well to beat Flynn of T.V.H., while Frank Webb sportingly turned out and gained points by finishing 4th.
We had a surprise in the 440 yards, inasmuch as both our runners won their heats, and so we had two in the final. Dick Michael and Syd Jarlett were our two stalwarts, but on a very loose track G.

The 440 yards saw Dick Michael run a smashing race to beat Syd Jarlett, with the Southgate men well in the rear. Points which were scored 4, 3, 2, 1, were equally shared in the Discus Throw, and also the 2 Miles, which E.
Dick Michael led the others at the last bend and looked as though he would be runner-up, but Sid Jarlett had other ideas, fought him down the straight, and just “pipped” him.
Eric Herbert also stationed far away, and enjoys a run when home on leave. Dick Michael (Lieut.
Gordon Harvey is now fit and well in India, and, through his parents, has expressed his continued interest in the Club's activities. Dick Michael has left H.M.S.
Dick Michael is now a Lt.-Commander on H.M.S. "Myrmidon," where he is the Commanding Officer.
440 yds D G Michael, H E Pack, reserves T H Scrimshaw & A A Bird. 880 yds L W Herbert, A A Bird reserves T H Scrimshaw, W E Lucas, F H C White.
